units: SI; lengths in mm unless stated

rules.title: Approved stack-up must be complete and traceable
rules.action: Block impedance/routing-rule generation if copper layers, copper weight, dielectric thickness, Dk/Df, materials or fabricator provenance are missing.
rules.limitations: Dk/Df requires material grade, test frequency and provenance; a material name is not an electrical parameter.

rules.title: Impedance must use the actual layer-stack construction
rules.action: Obtain a board-house impedance result or verified 2D/3D field solve before freezing trace widths and spacing.
rules.limitations: There is no universal width/impedance formula independent of actual stack-up.

rules.title: Every impedance-controlled net needs a sourced target
rules.action: Enter impedance targets from the exact device datasheet, interface specification or system contract and cite that source; never guess from bus name.
rules.limitations: A target impedance is not a measured or field-solved geometry result.

rules.title: Impedance geometry requires solver or fabricator evidence
rules.action: Archive width, clearance, dielectric, copper, characteristic impedance, tolerance, solver version and actual report.
rules.limitations: KiCad DRC checks supplied geometry, not the true transmission-line impedance.

rules.title: Classify high-speed nets using edge and interface conditions
rules.action: Record interface, data rate/clock, rise/fall time where known, topology and net class; judge transmission-line effects from edges and interconnect length, not clock alone.
rules.limitations: The current tool checks required fields; it does not independently detect a universal high-speed threshold.

rules.title: Differential pairs need exact pairing and a timing budget
rules.action: Define P/N identity, impedance, permitted layers, topology, length/skew budget and source from the applicable interface specification.
rules.limitations: Do not impose one fixed impedance or length tolerance on every differential pair.

rules.title: Convert length matching from an explicit timing budget
rules.action: Retain the original time budget and convert allowable length difference using verified propagation delay.
rules.limitations: Do not replace timing requirements with arbitrary millimetres; velocity depends on layer and structure.

rules.title: High-speed signals require an identified continuous return path
rules.action: Examine reference-plane splits, openings and boundaries, and verify a low-inductance return transition for layer changes.
rules.limitations: Connectivity and DRC alone do not prove a sound return-current path.

rules.title: High-speed via transitions require discontinuity and stub evaluation
rules.action: Record signal vias, antipads, reference vias, stub/backdrill conditions; assess backdrilling or blind/buried vias from the real channel budget.
rules.limitations: No fixed count or backdrill threshold applies universally to all frequencies and stacks.

rules.title: Crosstalk spacing must come from a budget or simulation
rules.action: Evaluate parallel length, stack-up, separation, reference plane and edge rate; record NEXT/FEXT or equivalent metrics.
rules.limitations: The 3W heuristic alone is not proof that crosstalk passes.

rules.title: PDN rail target impedance must be calculated
rules.action: Calculate Ztarget = Vrail * ripple_fraction / Itransient and compare the configured limit to the calculation.
rules.limitations: This is an initial target; frequency-domain PDN simulation needs an explicit band and model.

rules.title: Decoupling requires real parasitics and PDN evidence
rules.action: Use bias/temperature-adjusted capacitance, ESR, ESL and mounting/spreading inductance; evaluate impedance and antiresonance across the required band.
rules.limitations: A generic 0.1uF capacitor per supply pin is not a PDN design method.

rules.title: Minimize critical current and high-speed return loops
rules.action: Inspect switching-converter hot loops, clocks, connector common-mode paths, planes and shielding/filtering choices.
rules.limitations: Final EMC compliance needs applicable standards, defined configurations and laboratory measurements.

rules.title: Verify ampacity and temperature rise under IPC-2152 conditions
rules.action: Assess actual trace/via geometry, copper thickness, ambient, allowable rise, inner/outer placement and cooling environment.
rules.limitations: One line-width chart is not universal across PCB materials, copper weights and thermal environments.

rules.title: Geometry constraints must use the actual fabricator capability
rules.action: Import the selected fabricator process, material, layer count, copper weight and production class, then map to KiCad DRC.
rules.limitations: Different process/layer/copper classes are not interchangeable defaults.

rules.title: Track native DRC evidence separately from SI PI and EMC evidence
rules.action: Archive current PCB revision, engineering report, tool version, input hash, conclusion and authorized reviewer.
rules.limitations: Passing DRC does not certify electrical performance or grant manufacturing authorization.
